segs.en: Sensible gambling is crucial to ensure that the activity remains enjoyable and does not spiral into harmful behavior. It involves setting limits on time and money spent, understanding the risks, and knowing when to walk away. By practicing self-control and being aware of the potential consequences, individuals can avoid the dangers of addiction and financial strain. Responsible gambling encourages balance, helping players enjoy the experience without it negatively impacting their lives or well-being.

zh.ai: 理性赌博对于确保这项活动保持愉快、避免演变为有害行为至关重要。这包括限制投入的时间和金钱、了解其中的风险，并知道何时收手。通过保持自我控制并意识到潜在后果，人们可以避免成瘾和经济压力带来的危险。负责任的赌博倡导保持平衡，帮助参与者享受这一过程，同时避免对自己的生活或身心健康产生负面影响。

segs.en: You have $$$k$$$ amount of money which u are ready to risk for gambling and your goal is to have the most amount of money in the end

zh.ai: 你有 $$$k$$$ 资金愿意用于赌博，你的目标是在最后拥有尽可能多的钱。

segs.en: You are given an array of n integers which determine the money gained or lost playing the ith game.

zh.ai: 给定一个由 n 个整数构成的数组，这些整数表示玩第 i 场游戏时获得或损失的钱数。

segs.en: Here's the description of the game, you can start playing from any index you want. Note that you can back out at any time

zh.ai: 以下是游戏描述，你可以从任意下标开始游玩。注意，你可以随时退出。

segs.en: If you are currently playing game $$$i$$$, and this is your $$$j$$$'th game so far; Then the next game that you will be playing is game $$$i + j$$$

zh.ai: 如果你当前正在进行第 $$$i$$$ 局游戏，并且这是你目前为止进行的第 $$$j$$$ 局游戏，那么你接下来要进行的是第 $$$i + j$$$ 局游戏。

segs.en: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \leq t \leq 500$$$) — the number of testcases

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \leq t \leq 500$$$)——测试用例的数量。

segs.en: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 2*10^5$$$) — the size of the array and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \leq k \leq 10^9$$$) — the initial money you hold

zh.ai: 第一行包含两个整数：$$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 2*10^5$$$)——数组的大小，以及 $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \leq k \leq 10^9$$$)——你持有的初始金额。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$) — the game.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$) —— 这就是游戏。

segs.en: For each test, print the maximum amount of money u can hold after playing the most desirable situation

zh.ai: 对于每组测试，输出在采取最优策略后你能持有的最大金额。

segs.en: Hermenegilda is training to compete in the International Olympiad in Informatics, but she doesn't have much time left. After pondering for a while about what strategy she should follow, she has decided that the best thing she can do is to stop studying and focus her efforts on becoming a Russian contestant, as this way she is sure to win a medal. To achieve this goal, she travels to the Federal Amusement Park of Kazan, famous for its authentically Russian roller coasters.

zh.ai: Hermenegilda 正在为参加国际信息学奥林匹克竞赛而训练，但她剩下的时间不多了。思考了一会儿该采取什么策略后，她决定最好的办法就是停止学习，把精力集中在成为一名俄罗斯选手上，因为这样她肯定能赢得一枚奖牌。为了实现这个目标，她前往喀山联邦游乐园，这里以其地道的俄罗斯过山车而闻名。

segs.en: An authentically Russian roller coaster is an attraction that consists of $$$2l$$$ segments, placed one after the other. There are only two types of segments: ascending and descending. Each segment measures exactly one Russian unit of length in its horizontal component and one Russian unit of length in its vertical component. That is, each segment advances one Russian unit of length upward or downward and one Russian unit of length horizontally, depending on whether it is an ascending or descending segment. Furthermore, authentically Russian roller coasters have no segments underground and start and end at ground level. Surprisingly, the Federal Amusement Park of Kazan contains all possible authentically Russian roller coasters.

zh.ai: 一座真正的俄罗斯过山车是一种由 $$$2l$$$ 段首尾相接组成的游乐设施。每段只有两种类型：上坡段和下坡段。每段在水平方向和垂直方向上的长度都恰好为一个俄罗斯长度单位。也就是说，根据该段是上坡段还是下坡段，它会在水平方向前进一个俄罗斯长度单位，并在垂直方向上升或下降一个俄罗斯长度单位。此外，真正的俄罗斯过山车不会有任何部分位于地下，且起点和终点都在地面上。令人惊讶的是，喀山联邦游乐园包含了所有可能的真正的俄罗斯过山车。

segs.en: In her effort to become a Russian contestant, Hermenegilda starts her training methodically: she wants to ride all the authentically Russian roller coasters that have a length of $$$2l$$$ Russian units and a height of exactly $$$h$$$ Russian units; that is, their highest point is $$$h$$$ Russian units above ground level. We ask you to tell us how many authentically Russian roller coasters Hermenegilda will need to ride.

zh.ai: 为了成为一名俄罗斯选手，Hermenegilda 开始有条不紊地训练：她想乘坐所有长度为 $$$2l$$$ 俄罗斯单位、高度恰好为 $$$h$$$ 俄罗斯单位的正宗俄罗斯过山车；也就是说，这些过山车的最高点比地面高 $$$h$$$ 俄罗斯单位。请告诉我们，Hermenegilda 需要乘坐多少辆正宗俄罗斯过山车。

segs.en: The first line contains a single positive integer $$$t$$$, the total number of cases. The following $$$t$$$ lines, one for each case, each consist of two positive integers: $$$l$$$ and $$$h$$$.

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个正整数 $$$t$$$，表示测试用例总数。接下来的 $$$t$$$ 行每行对应一个测试用例，每行包含两个正整数：$$$l$$$ 和 $$$h$$$。

segs.en: For each case, you must print a single integer: the number of attractions of length $$$2l$$$ and height $$$h$$$ that Hermenegilda will ride. Since this number can be very large, we ask you to print it modulo 1000000007.

zh.ai: 对于每组数据，你必须输出一个整数：Hermenegilda 将乘坐的长度为 $$$2l$$$ 且高度为 $$$h$$$ 的游乐设施数量。由于这个数量可能非常大，请输出其对 1000000007 取模后的结果。
